summary.result: The visual inspection and a quantitative verification using a visibility meter showed that the DFDA successfully detected a wide range of fog.
summary.background: In this study, a hybrid-type of day fog detection algorithm (DFDA) was developed based on the optical and textural characteristics of fog top, using the Himawari-8 /Advanced Himawari Imager data.
